sn8.4:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam āyasmā Ānando Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || || Atha kho āyasmā Ānando pubbaṇha-samayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Sāvatthiṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi āyasmatā Vaṅgīsena pacchāsamaṇena || || Tena kho pana samayena āyasmato Vaṅgīsassa anabhirati uppannā hoti || rāgo cittam anuddhaṃseti || || Atha kho āyasmā Vaṅgīso āyasmantam Ānandam gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn8.4:2.1: Kāmarāgena ḍayhāmi || cittam me pariḍayhati || sādhu nibbāpanaṃ brūhi || anukampāya Gotamā ti || ||
sn8.4:3.1: Saññāya vipariyesā || cittan-te pariḍayhati || nimittam parivajjehi || subhaṃ rāgūpasaṃhitaṃ ||
sn8.4:4.1: Saṅkhāre parato passa || dukkhato mā ca attato || nibbāpehi mahārāgaṃ || mā ḍayhittho punappunaṃ || ||
sn8.4:5.1: asubhāya cittaṃ bhāvehi || ekaggaṃ susamāhitaṃ || sati kāyagatā ty-atthu || nibbidā-bahulo bhava || ||
sn8.4:6.1: animittaṃ ca bhāvehi || mānānusayam ujjaha || tato mānābhisamayā || upasanto carissasī ti || ||
